Flashcards
从十三本手册各章的自测题、练习和面试题库里抽出的题目与答案，共 … 张。按间隔重复复习：答不上来的明天再见，记住了的隔几天、几周再出现。复习记录只保存在本浏览器，可以在学习路线图导出、导入全站进度；也可以导出到 Anki。

Questions and answers taken from the self-tests, exercises and interview questions in all thirteen handbooks, … of them. Reviewed by spaced repetition: what you miss comes back tomorrow, what you remember returns in days or weeks. The review record stays in this browser only; the whole site's progress can be exported and imported on the learning roadmap, and the cards exported to Anki.
